title: When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured as a mail proxy, undisclosed traffic can cause a… (CVE-2026-113425)
description: CVE-2026-113425 is a use-after-free vulnerability in NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source when configured as a mail proxy. This flaw allows remote unauthenticated attackers to crash an nginx worker process or corrupt its memory, potentially disrupting service. Remote code execution is possible if Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) is disabled or bypassed. The vulnerability affects the data plane only, with no control plane exposure. No affected versions or patches have been specified. The CVSS score is 8.1, indicating high severity.
